PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build lean muscle mass on a whole-food plant-based diet"

PHASES

  PHASE "Foundation — Motor Patterns & Volume Base" (4 weeks):

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
          tricep_stretch 60s

      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower A — Quad Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          forward_fold 60s

      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Pull A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          face_pull 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          lat_stretch 60s

          shoulder_stretch 60s
